test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 01 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some tapes are glue.

Some glue are paints.

All paints are computers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tapes are paints.

II. All glue are paints.

III. Some glue are computers.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b36e21c6a5be876db9b092ee8813c3b1489e179dd730ede42216ad5e245229f3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tapes are paints → Does not Follow (As, some tapes are glue and some glue are paints. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. All glue are paints → Does not Follow (As, some glue are paints. So, some part of glue is common with paints therefore it is false.)

III. Some glue are computers → Follow (As, some glue are paints and all paints are computers . So, whole paints comes in computers and have some part common with glue therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion III follows".
